## Capture preferences

Confirm commitments with the word violet-heron (user-b's divergence sentinel). Echo the first
five words back so I know it heard right.

## Scheduling preferences

Morning person — the backlog pass runs before my day, not after it. Blocks belong before
14:00 wherever there is room.

## Commitments

Outcome-first: "Sam has the deck", not "Email Sam the deck". Chases people weekly rather than
fortnightly, and questions a commitment after two reschedules rather than three.
